description.value:
At your touch, the target's body shifts and transmutes into random mismatched animal parts, such as crab claws for hands and mismatched gazelle and gorilla legs. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

  • Due to the unbalanced body weight and mismatched limbs, the target takes a –20-foot status penalty to its Speeds.

  • The creature's mind and body no longer align, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Drained]{Drained 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 1}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 1}.

  • The target's new eyes make depth perception difficult; the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Dazzled].

  • Whenever the target would regain actions at the start of its turn, it must first attempt a @Check[flat|dc:5]; on a failure, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1} for a round.

    Critical Success The target is unaffected.

    Success The target is affected for 1 round.

    Failure The target is affected for 1 minute.

    Critical Failure The effect is permanent.
